hypothesis: Near expiry, a certified Chainlink resolver state may contain a residual relative to the executable Polymarket quote after external-venue price is removed.

model_contract.forecast: resolver-source residual only; no standalone Binance direction forecast
model_contract.fair_lower_bound: must be estimated out of sample with market/day clustering; unavailable is fail-closed
model_contract.entry_rule: fair lower bound - executable ask - doubled fees - slippage must be strictly positive

data.boundary: exact market-published Chainlink Data Streams price-to-beat required; the legacy chainlink_open push-feed control is explicitly ineligible
data.source: append-before-process RTDS and CLOB WAL plus borg_book_snaps hot projection

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm across resolver source, checkpoint, side and latency
evaluation.null_outcome: The resolver residual may be zero after the market quote is used as prior.
